# Recommendations reference

Contract `factorymeter/v1`. 19 rules.

A report says where to invest. Every recommendation in it comes from one of the rules listed here. The same list is in [`metrics.json`](metrics.json) under `recommendation_rules`, and `factorymeter rules` prints it.

## How a recommendation is made

- A rule is a fixed test on the numbers of the report. It fires or it does not. Nothing is guessed and no model is asked.
- A station is compared with itself, not with other companies: with its own best 4 weeks in a row inside the window of the report. A stretch counts only when at least 5 items left the station in it. A window of 4 weeks or less has no best weeks, and the gain is not sized.
- Hours freed a week is the waiting that goes away if the station gets back to that pace. It is waiting time of changes, not working time of people. A rule that cannot size its gain leaves it empty. A gain of 0 means no stretch of the window did better.
- The order is: the constraint first, then the largest hours freed, then the rest in the order of this page.
- Confidence is how much data stands behind the numbers: high from 30 items, medium from 10, low below that. For a sized gain it is the smaller of the items in the window and the items in the best weeks. A rule that counts what stands in a queue is always high.
- Every recommendation carries its evidence: each number the rule read, the number it was compared with, and a sentence that says both.
- A rule about a queue names up to 5 items to look at first, the one that has stood longest first. A summary names none.
- A rule id never changes meaning. A rule whose test has to change gets a new id.

## The rules

| Rule | Station | What it recommends | Sizes its gain |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`code.slow`](#rule-code-slow) | Code | Get changes ready for review sooner | yes |
| [`ci.slow`](#rule-ci-slow) | CI | Make CI rounds shorter | yes |
| [`verify.slow`](#rule-verify-slow) | Verify | Bring changes up on an environment faster | yes |
| [`review.slow`](#rule-review-slow) | Review | Cut the wait for review | yes |
| [`merge.slow`](#rule-merge-slow) | Merge | Merge finished changes sooner | yes |
| [`release.slow`](#rule-release-slow) | Release | Release more often | yes |
| [`verify.missing`](#rule-verify-missing) | Verify | Prove changes on a running environment before they merge | no |
| [`ci.failing`](#rule-ci-failing) | CI | Cut the share of CI rounds that fail | yes |
| [`ci.agents-fail-more`](#rule-ci-agents-fail-more) | CI | Have agents run the checks before they push | no |
| [`merge.reverted`](#rule-merge-reverted) | Merge | Find out why merged changes get reverted | no |
| [`code.abandoned`](#rule-code-abandoned) | Code | Find out why changes are closed without merging | no |
| [`review.queue-growing`](#rule-review-queue-growing) | Review | Clear the review queue | no |
| [`merge.approved-waiting`](#rule-merge-approved-waiting) | Merge | Merge the changes that are already approved | no |
| [`code.stale-drafts`](#rule-code-stale-drafts) | Code | Finish or close the drafts that stopped moving | no |
| [`spec.reopened`](#rule-spec-reopened) | Spec | Find out why finished tickets are opened again | no |
| [`spec.stale-tickets`](#rule-spec-stale-tickets) | Spec | Close or schedule the tickets nobody has started | no |

## Get changes ready for review sooner

<a id="rule-code-slow"></a>Rule `code.slow`. Station: Code.

- Fires when: The station is the constraint. Or it holds an item at least 25 percent longer than in its own best four weeks, and running at that pace would give back at least 5 percent of the hours changes are held before the merge.
- Reads: `code.held.total`, `code.held.share`, `code.work.p50`.
- Hours freed: The mean hours an item is held at the station now, less the same mean in the station's best four weeks, times the items that leave the station in a week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the items it is averaged with.
- Practice: [decide up front](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/decide-up-front/)

## Make CI rounds shorter

<a id="rule-ci-slow"></a>Rule `ci.slow`. Station: CI.

- Fires when: The station is the constraint. Or it holds an item at least 25 percent longer than in its own best four weeks, and running at that pace would give back at least 5 percent of the hours changes are held before the merge.
- Reads: `ci.held.total`, `ci.held.share`, `ci.work.p50`, `ci.wait.p50`.
- Hours freed: The mean hours an item is held at the station now, less the same mean in the station's best four weeks, times the items that leave the station in a week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the items it is averaged with.
- Practice: [find the constraint](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/find-the-constraint/)

## Bring changes up on an environment faster

<a id="rule-verify-slow"></a>Rule `verify.slow`. Station: Verify.

- Fires when: The station is the constraint. Or it holds an item at least 25 percent longer than in its own best four weeks, and running at that pace would give back at least 5 percent of the hours changes are held before the merge.
- Reads: `verify.held.total`, `verify.held.share`, `verify.wait.p50`, `verify.work.p50`.
- Hours freed: The mean hours an item is held at the station now, less the same mean in the station's best four weeks, times the items that leave the station in a week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the items it is averaged with.
- Practice: [environment per agent](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/environment-per-agent/)

## Cut the wait for review

<a id="rule-review-slow"></a>Rule `review.slow`. Station: Review.

- Fires when: The station is the constraint. Or it holds an item at least 25 percent longer than in its own best four weeks, and running at that pace would give back at least 5 percent of the hours changes are held before the merge.
- Reads: `review.held.total`, `review.held.share`, `review.wait.p50`, `review.work.p50`, `review.queue`.
- Hours freed: The mean hours an item is held at the station now, less the same mean in the station's best four weeks, times the items that leave the station in a week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the items it is averaged with.
- Practice: [trust is earned with evidence](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/trust-is-earned-with-evidence/)

## Merge finished changes sooner

<a id="rule-merge-slow"></a>Rule `merge.slow`. Station: Merge.

- Fires when: The station is the constraint. Or it holds an item at least 25 percent longer than in its own best four weeks, and running at that pace would give back at least 5 percent of the hours changes are held before the merge.
- Reads: `merge.held.total`, `merge.held.share`, `merge.wait.p50`, `merge.queue`.
- Hours freed: The mean hours an item is held at the station now, less the same mean in the station's best four weeks, times the items that leave the station in a week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the items it is averaged with.
- Practice: [out of the synchronous loop](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/out-of-the-synchronous-loop/)

## Release more often

<a id="rule-release-slow"></a>Rule `release.slow`. Station: Release.

- Fires when: The station is the constraint. Or it holds an item at least 25 percent longer than in its own best four weeks, and running at that pace would give back at least 5 percent of the hours changes are held on the whole line.
- Reads: `release.held.total`, `release.held.share`, `release.wait.p50`, `release.deploys`, `release.queue`.
- Hours freed: The mean hours an item is held at the station now, less the same mean in the station's best four weeks, times the items that leave the station in a week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the items it is averaged with.
- Practice: [find the constraint](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/find-the-constraint/)

## Prove changes on a running environment before they merge

<a id="rule-verify-missing"></a>Rule `verify.missing`. Station: Verify.

- Fires when: The verify station is not connected, and at least 50 percent of the changes merged in the window had no review by another person.
- Reads: `review.skipped`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [agents prove their work](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/agents-prove-their-work/)

## Cut the share of CI rounds that fail

<a id="rule-ci-failing"></a>Rule `ci.failing`. Station: CI.

- Fires when: At least 15 percent of the CI rounds in the window failed, timed out or were run again.
- Reads: `ci.rework`, `ci.flow`, `ci.work.p50`.
- Hours freed: The share of failed rounds now, less the share in the best four weeks, times the rounds in a week, times the mean hours a round holds a change.

## Have agents run the checks before they push

<a id="rule-ci-agents-fail-more"></a>Rule `ci.agents-fail-more`. Station: CI.

- Fires when: CI rounds on changes by agents fail at least 5 points more often than rounds on changes by people. Both sides are drawn from at least 5 items.
- Reads: `ci.rework`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [agents prove their work](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/agents-prove-their-work/)

## Find out why merged changes get reverted

<a id="rule-merge-reverted"></a>Rule `merge.reverted`. Station: Merge.

- Fires when: At least 5 percent of the changes merged in the window were reverted later, and at least 3 of them.
- Reads: `merge.rework`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [agents prove their work](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/agents-prove-their-work/)

## Find out why changes are closed without merging

<a id="rule-code-abandoned"></a>Rule `code.abandoned`. Station: Code.

- Fires when: At least 20 percent of the changes closed in the window were closed without merging.
- Reads: `code.rework`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [decide up front](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/decide-up-front/)

## Clear the review queue

<a id="rule-review-queue-growing"></a>Rule `review.queue-growing`. Station: Review.

- Fires when: At least 5 changes wait for a first review at the end of the window, and the trend of the queue is worse: it is longer than at the end of the window before by more than the report calls flat. The rule is silent when no change in the store was ever reviewed by another person.
- Reads: `review.queue`, `review.queue.oldest`, `review.wait.p50`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [trust is earned with evidence](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/trust-is-earned-with-evidence/)

## Merge the changes that are already approved

<a id="rule-merge-approved-waiting"></a>Rule `merge.approved-waiting`. Station: Merge.

- Fires when: At least 3 changes have been approved for more than 24 hours and are not merged at the end of the window.
- Reads: `merge.queue`, `merge.queue.oldest`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [out of the synchronous loop](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/out-of-the-synchronous-loop/)

## Finish or close the drafts that stopped moving

<a id="rule-code-stale-drafts"></a>Rule `code.stale-drafts`. Station: Code.

- Fires when: At least 3 changes have been a draft for more than 14 days at the end of the window.
- Reads: `code.queue`, `code.queue.oldest`.
- Hours freed: not sized.

## Find out why finished tickets are opened again

<a id="rule-spec-reopened"></a>Rule `spec.reopened`. Station: Spec.

- Fires when: At least 10 percent of the tickets finished in the window had been finished before and were opened again. The share is drawn from at least 5 tickets.
- Reads: `spec.rework`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [decide up front](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/decide-up-front/)

## Close or schedule the tickets nobody has started

<a id="rule-spec-stale-tickets"></a>Rule `spec.stale-tickets`. Station: Spec.

- Fires when: At least 5 tickets have been open for more than 90 days at the end of the window with no work started on them.
- Reads: `spec.queue`, `spec.queue.oldest`.
- Hours freed: not sized.

## Write up more work that is ready to start

<a id="rule-spec-backlog-thin"></a>Rule `spec.backlog-thin`. Station: Spec.

- Fires when: Fewer tickets are open and not started at the end of the window than the line starts in one week. The pace is drawn from at least 5 tickets started in the window.
- Reads: `spec.queue`, `spec.flow`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [keep the line fed](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/keep-the-line-fed/)

## Find out why changes by agents wait longer for review

<a id="rule-review-agents-wait-longer"></a>Rule `review.agents-wait-longer`. Station: Review.

- Fires when: The median wait for a first review is at least 1.5 times as long for changes by agents as for changes by people, and at least 1 hour longer. Both sides are drawn from at least 5 items.
- Reads: `review.wait.p50`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
- Practice: [trust is earned with evidence](https://thesoftwarefactory.site/playbook/trust-is-earned-with-evidence/)

## Have agents ship smaller changes

<a id="rule-code-agent-changes-large"></a>Rule `code.agent-changes-large`. Station: Code.

- Fires when: The median change by an agent is at least 2 times the size of the median change by a person, and at least 200 lines. Both sides are drawn from at least 5 items.
- Reads: `line.size.p50`.
- Hours freed: not sized.
